In Three Solids every shadow falls to the right: one lamp, outside the frame, lights all three

Mira Okafor born 1987

Three Solids, 2026

Painted plywood disc, pyramid and cylinder; one lamp

Studio rendering of the installation for Gallery 4

The disc, the pyramid and the cylinder stand on one floor and lean their shadows the same way, toward the right. The lamp is never seen; the floor they share is part of the work.

Caffè Ostro pulls its double in 27 seconds: 18 grams in, 36 out

The shot runs dark and slow, and the crema is still a firm hazel ring when the cup reaches the table. It is served on a warm saucer with a glass of soda water.

Dose18 g
Yield36 g
Brew ratio1 : 2.0
Time27 s
Price€2.80

Photo: double espresso, CC0; 600 × 400 px shown at 1.30×Crop toward the subject 53% of the width kept, centred on the cup

A 1 : 2 double at home, in four steps

  1. Weigh 18 g of beans and grind them fine, like table salt.
  2. Level the basket and tamp once, firmly and flat.
  3. Stop the shot at 36 g, about 27 seconds after the pump starts.
  4. Drink it within a minute, while the crema still holds.

You needa scale that reads to 0.1 g, an 18 g double basket, a tamper and a timer.

The Caffè Ostro double on its saucer, photographed from above at the bar.

Why the towers stand taller than the rocket

Four lattice towers ring the pad. The wires strung from their masts, not the vehicle, are meant to take a lightning strike.
